title: Hotels, Flying and Ships
intro: Hotel management, pilot, cabin crew, aircraft engineer and ship officer.

nodes.label: Airline cabin crew hiring
nodes.note: Class 12 pass, good English and Hindi, and the airline height and age rules. Airlines hire through interviews.

nodes.label: Aircraft engineer entry
nodes.note: Class 12 with PCM, or an engineering diploma after Class 10. Join a DGCA-approved college.

nodes.label: BSc Hospitality (3 years)
nodes.note: At Institutes of Hotel Management, for example IHM Bangalore.

nodes.label: Pilot training (CPL)
nodes.note: Ground exams and flying hours. A Class 1 medical is needed.

nodes.label: Cabin crew course
nodes.note: A short course on service, safety and grooming.

nodes.label: BSc Nautical Science or BTech Marine
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years at the Indian Maritime University and similar colleges.

nodes.label: Cabin crew
nodes.note: Look after passengers in the air.

nodes.label: Ship officer
nodes.note: Deck or engine officer on a merchant ship.
